start_0.title: The Gilded Ace
start_0.text: You are Edward, a young soldier on the long road home. Rain hammers the windows as you sit by the fire with a warm mug. Anna, the barkeep's daughter, sets down a bowl of stew and smiles. "You look like you've come a long way."

start_1.title: CRASH!
start_1.text: The door bursts open. Goblins and bandits pour in! Before anyone can move, two bandits grab Anna and drag her, kicking and screaming, down the cellar stairs. A snarling goblin blocks your way.

start_2.title: Cards of Power!
start_2.text: "They took my Anna!" Old Bram tosses you a glowing deck of cards. "Cards of Power! Make a poker hand and it turns into an attack. The better the hand, the harder you hit. Please, Edward... bring my daughter home!"

a1_0.title: Into the Cellar
a1_0.text: The Bandit Chief laughs as he falls. "Too late, hero. The girl is already on her way to the master." On the cellar stairs you find Anna's red ribbon. You grab a torch and head down into the dark.

a2_0.title: The Dark Forest
a2_0.text: Behind a cracked cellar wall, a secret tunnel leads out into the Dark Forest. Anna's scarf hangs on a branch. Fresh footprints lead deeper into the trees, where wolves are howling.

a3_0.title: Castle Grimstone
a3_0.text: At the edge of the forest stands Castle Grimstone. From the tallest tower, you hear Anna calling for help. Then a huge shadow crosses the moon. The master is a dragon.

end_0.title: The dragon falls!
end_0.text: With one last mighty hand, the Grimstone Dragon crashes to the ground. Its monsters scatter into the hills.

end_1.title: Anna is free
end_1.text: You race up the tower stairs and break the lock. Anna throws her arms around you. "I knew someone would come," she whispers.

end_2.title: Hero of the Gilded Ace
end_2.text: Back at the Gilded Ace, Old Bram hugs his daughter and won't let go. Then he pours you a drink on the house. "To the hero who brought my Anna home!" The whole pub cheers.

end_3.title: Arise, Sir Edward
end_3.text: Word reaches the King. In the great hall he lays his sword on your shoulder. "Kneel, Edward. For saving Anna and Castle Grimstone... rise, Sir Edward, Knight of the Realm!" But the kingdom has more trouble, and the King needs his newest knight.

w2_start_0.title: A summons from the King
w2_start_0.text: A royal rider gallops into the Gilded Ace. "Sir Edward! The Frost Giant has stolen the King's Frost Crown. Without it, winter will never end."

w2_start_1.title: Into the snow
w2_start_1.text: Anna presses a warm cloak into your hands. "Come back to us, Sir Edward." You ride north, where the mountains are white and the wind howls like wolves.

w2_end_0.title: The crown returns
w2_end_0.text: The Frost Giant crashes down like a falling mountain. You lift the Frost Crown from the snow, and the clouds begin to part.

w2_end_1.title: Spring comes
w2_end_1.text: The King places the crown on his head and warm wind sweeps the land. "Rest well, Sir Edward. I fear we will need you again soon."

w2_a1_0.title: The Ice Caves
w2_a1_0.text: The Yeti Chieftain falls in the snow. Huge footprints lead into a cave that glitters like a thousand blue diamonds.

w2_a2_0.title: The Frozen Lake
w2_a2_0.text: Beyond the caves lies a frozen lake. On the far shore, the Frost Giant's hall smokes with blue fire.

w2_a3_0.title: The Giant's Hall
w2_a3_0.text: The Frost Wyrm sinks beneath the ice. The doors of the Giant's hall stand open, and from inside comes a laugh like an avalanche.

w3_start_0.title: A cry for help
w3_start_0.text: A caravan carrying the kingdom's medicine has vanished in the Burning Sands. The last message says only: "The dead walk at night."

w3_start_1.title: The endless desert
w3_start_1.text: You cross the dunes under a blazing sun. Far away, half buried in sand, stands an ancient pyramid.

w3_end_0.title: The caravan is free
w3_end_0.text: The Scorched King falls and the flames go out. You break the merchants' chains, and they weep with joy.

w3_end_1.title: Medicine for the kingdom
w3_end_1.text: The caravan rolls home with its medicine. Children cheer as Sir Edward rides beside the wagons.

w3_a1_0.title: The Oasis Ruins
w3_a1_0.text: From inside the Sand Wyrm's coils you pull a torn caravan flag. Its trail leads to an old oasis in ruins.

w3_a2_0.title: The Pyramid
w3_a2_0.text: The Djinn vanishes in smoke and leaves behind a golden key. It fits the great door of the pyramid.

w3_a3_0.title: The Sun Temple
w3_a3_0.text: The Pharaoh crumbles to dust. Through a hidden passage you climb toward the Sun Temple, where the merchants are chained.

w4_start_0.title: Ships are vanishing
w4_start_0.text: Every ship that sails past the Sunken Coast disappears. Fishermen whisper about a giant bell ringing under the waves.

w4_start_1.title: To the coast
w4_start_1.text: You sail out on a fishing boat. Fog rolls in, and somewhere below the water, a bell begins to toll.

w4_end_0.title: The bell falls silent
w4_end_0.text: The Kraken lets go and sinks into the deep. You cut the bell's chain, and the sea goes calm and still.

w4_end_1.title: Safe waters
w4_end_1.text: Ships sail the coast again. The fishermen name their best boat the Sir Edward.

w4_a1_0.title: The Shipwreck
w4_a1_0.text: Captain Blacktide's map shows a wreck below the cove. You drink a sea-witch's potion, take a deep breath and dive.

w4_a2_0.title: The Coral Depths
w4_a2_0.text: Past the ghost ship, the sea floor opens into a forest of glowing coral. The bell's toll shakes the water.

w4_a3_0.title: The Drowned Temple
w4_a3_0.text: The Sea Serpent sinks into the dark. Ahead lies a temple, and inside it a giant bronze bell wrapped in tentacles.

w5_start_0.title: A sickness spreads
w5_start_0.text: A green fog drifts out of the Plague Marsh, and everyone it touches falls ill. An old healer begs for help: "Someone is brewing the curse."

w5_start_1.title: Into the fog
w5_start_1.text: You wrap a cloth over your face and wade into the marsh. The trees are dead and the water bubbles.

w5_end_0.title: The cauldron breaks
w5_end_0.text: The Bog Hag shrieks and melts into the mud. You kick over her cauldron, and the green fog drains away.

w5_end_1.title: The healing
w5_end_1.text: The sick wake up healthy. The old healer bows. "The whole kingdom owes you its life, Sir Edward."

w5_a1_0.title: The Plague Village
w5_a1_0.text: The Croc sinks into the muck. Beyond the reeds, an empty village sits on stilts, its lanterns still burning.

w5_a2_0.title: The Witch's Bog
w5_a2_0.text: In the Plague Beast's den you find empty potion jars, all marked with the same witch's sign. It points to the bog.

w5_a3_0.title: The Hag's Lair
w5_a3_0.text: The Bog Troll falls with a splash. Inside a giant rotting tree, a green cauldron bubbles, and a cackle echoes.

w6_start_0.title: The forge goes cold
w6_start_0.text: The dwarves of the Iron Mines have sent no iron for months. A wounded dwarf crawls into the castle: "The golems woke up... they took the Great Forge!"

w6_start_1.title: Into the mountain
w6_start_1.text: You light a lantern and step into the mine. Deep below, something heavy goes thump... thump... thump.

w6_end_0.title: The forge burns again
w6_end_0.text: The Iron Golem crashes down. The dwarves break free and light the Great Forge with a mighty cheer.

w6_end_1.title: A gift of steel
w6_end_1.text: The dwarf king hands you a shield marked with your name. "No finer knight ever walked our halls, Sir Edward."

w6_a1_0.title: The Crystal Cavern
w6_a1_0.text: The Foreman drops a map scratched on leather. It shows a cavern full of crystals where the dwarves were taken.

w6_a2_0.title: The Lava Tunnels
w6_a2_0.text: Beyond the Drake's nest, the air turns hot. Rivers of lava light the way down to the Great Forge.

w6_a3_0.title: The Great Forge
w6_a3_0.text: The Lava Golem crumbles. Through the doors you see the dwarves chained to the anvils, and a giant made of iron.

w7_start_0.title: The bells stop
w7_start_0.text: The bells of the Holy Abbey have gone silent, and the monks have not been seen in weeks. At night, candles flicker in every window.

w7_start_1.title: The abbey gates
w7_start_1.text: The gates creak open on their own. A cold voice whispers your name: "Edwaaard..."

w7_end_0.title: The bells ring
w7_end_0.text: The Lich shatters into dust. You pull the great rope, and the bells ring out across the land for the first time in weeks.

w7_end_1.title: Peace returns
w7_end_1.text: The monks return, whole again. They carve your name in the abbey wall: Sir Edward, the Bell-Ringer.

w7_a1_0.title: The Cloister
w7_a1_0.text: The Headless Knight falls apart. A key on a black ribbon opens the abbey door, and the cold voice laughs inside.

w7_a2_0.title: The Catacombs
w7_a2_0.text: The Abbot sobs as the curse leaves him. "The Lich... he hides below, in the bones."

w7_a3_0.title: The Bell Tower
w7_a3_0.text: The Bone Dragon collapses into a pile of bones. Far above, in the tower, a green light pulses where the bells should ring.

w8_start_0.title: The forest turns dark
w8_start_0.text: The peaceful elves of the Wilds have stopped trading. Travelers come back covered in thorns, whispering about a queen with a heart of briars.

w8_start_1.title: The silver forest
w8_start_1.text: The trees of the Wilds shine like silver, but black thorns are choking them. Elven eyes watch you from the branches.

w8_end_0.title: The heart is free
w8_end_0.text: The thorns crumble from the Queen's crown. She opens her eyes, and they are kind again. "What have I done?"

w8_end_1.title: Friends of the forest
w8_end_1.text: The silver trees bloom. The Elf Queen gives you a leaf of pure silver. "The elves will always stand with Sir Edward."

w8_a1_0.title: The Moonlit Glade
w8_a1_0.text: The Briar Bear falls and the thorns pull back. A small elf girl peeks out from behind a tree. "Please... help our queen."

w8_a2_0.title: The Elven City
w8_a2_0.text: The Dark Unicorn's horn cracks, and its red glow fades. The elf girl leads you to a city in the trees, wrapped in thorns.

w8_a3_0.title: The Heart Tree
w8_a3_0.text: The Thorn General kneels, freed from the spell. "The queen took the Heart of the Forest. Save her... from herself."

w9_start_0.title: A storm that never ends
w9_start_0.text: Lightning strikes the kingdom every night, and a fortress has appeared floating in the clouds. The King's wizard says: "The Storm Titan has awoken."

w9_start_1.title: Up to the clouds
w9_start_1.text: The wizard's spell lifts you on a staircase of wind. Up and up you climb, into the storm.

w9_end_0.title: The storm breaks
w9_end_0.text: The Titan roars and fades into a harmless cloud. Sunlight pours over the fortress for the first time in a hundred years.

w9_end_1.title: A dark warning
w9_end_1.text: In the empty throne you find a black letter: "You cannot stop me forever. Come to the Abyss, Sir Edward." It is signed with a burning crown.

w9_a1_0.title: The Sky Gardens
w9_a1_0.text: The Griffon King bows his golden head and lets you ride on his back to the floating gardens.

w9_a2_0.title: The Fortress Walls
w9_a2_0.text: The Storm Drake falls into the clouds. Before you rise the huge walls of the Sky Fortress, crackling with lightning.

w9_a3_0.title: The Storm Throne
w9_a3_0.text: The Storm Giant topples off the walls. At the very top, on a throne of lightning, the Titan opens his eyes.

w10_start_0.title: The final quest
w10_start_0.text: The letter burns away in your hands. Every monster you ever fought was sent by one master: the Demon King, who waits in the Abyss.

w10_start_1.title: The gates of the Abyss
w10_start_1.text: Anna, Old Bram, the King and all your friends see you off. You step through the burning gates into darkness.

w10_end_0.title: The Demon King falls
w10_end_0.text: With one last mighty hand, the Demon King crashes from his throne. His burning crown rolls to your feet and goes dark.

w10_end_1.title: Legend of Sir Edward
w10_end_1.text: The whole kingdom celebrates for a week. Anna, Old Bram and the King raise their cups: "To Sir Edward, the greatest hero who ever lived!"

w10_end_2.title: But the darkness stirs...
w10_end_2.text: Deep in the Abyss, the shadows gather again. New monsters rise, stronger than ever. The Endless Quest begins.

w10_a1_0.title: The Chained Halls
w10_a1_0.text: Cerberus whimpers and runs off. Below, you hear the rattle of chains and the cries of the Demon King's prisoners.

w10_a2_0.title: The Lake of Fire
w10_a2_0.text: With the Warden's keys you free the prisoners. They point across a lake of fire to a castle of black glass.

w10_a3_0.title: The Demon Throne
w10_a3_0.text: The Flame Fiend sinks into the lake. The doors of the black castle open, and a voice like thunder says: "At last, Sir Edward."
